resources.string: A music capsule with your lockscreen player and a rope-swinging astronaut.
Show album art and slim animated bars while music plays. Tap to open the lockscreen media player.
An astronaut hangs from the island, swings with left/right gestures and waves for play or pause, then fades away.

The capsule appears during music playback. A pause gesture finishes a brief goodbye before it hides. The astronaut needs Motion Island enabled. Both hide on screen off and ambient display. Battery saver and reduced motion use a still pose and static bars. Existing gesture controls stay the same.
